channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Resilient Futures Call 2026: Ideation Grants (climate resilience and political leadership)
    https://www.betterpolitics.foundation/resilient-futures-call-2026
    Better Politics Fund, European Climate Foundation, Naia Trust and the Vibe Fund · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · USD 700,000 total across the whole call (Ideation plus Incubation streams). Ideation Grants: USD 10,000 to USD 20,000. Free to apply. Incubation Grants (up to USD 50,000) are by nomination only and have no application process.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• FUJIFILM GFX Challenge Grant Program 2026
    https://www.fujifilm-x.com/global/gfx-challenge-grant-program/year-2026/
    FUJIFILM · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · 5 Global Grant Awards of USD 10,000 and 10 Regional Grant Awards of USD 5,000. All recipients also get complimentary use of a GFX System camera body (including the FUJIFILM GFX ETERNA 55 filmmaking camera) and two GF lenses for the duration of the project, plus mentoring and technical assistance from Fujifilm technicians and product experts. Total approximate retail value of all awards: USD 229,500. No purchase necessary; no entry fee.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grant - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Research Trip to Switzerland
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/research-trip-to-switzerland/
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline Rolling / undated · Accommodation, travel costs, and daily allowances covered, plus a local coach (a cultural professional from the Swiss artistic field) to facilitate networking and exchange. Applicants with childcare responsibilities can request up to CHF 1,000 per month toward childcare or children's travel expenses. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Longview Philanthropy: Digital Minds Grants for Applied Work 2026
    https://www.longview.org/request-for-proposals-research-and-applied-work-on-digital-minds/
    Longview Philanthropy · deadline Closed 10 Jul 2026 · Typical grants $50,000–$2,000,000 per project; proposals outside this range considered when the work justifies it. May include some operational support for new organisations. No application fee.
  • Social Shifters Global Innovation Challenge 2026
    https://www.socialshifters.co/global-innovation-challenge/
    Social Shifters · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Multiple awards of up to USD 15,000 each (reported grants from USD 3,000 to USD 15,000), plus pitch coaching, a finalist showcase, free founder support from registration, and ongoing access to fellowships and paid work through the Shifters 100 alumni network that corporate partners recruit from. Free to enter.
